info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Model Financial Instrument Valuation Model-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of financial instrument valuation models within the banking sector. It enables financial analysts and model managers to develop and define complex valuation models that are essential for evaluating various financial instruments. By utilizing this endpoint, users can efficiently submit model specifications, ensuring that the instruments are assessed accurately and in a timely manner. Typical consumers include banks, investment firms, and financial service providers looking to enhance their valuation processes.

post.summary: Create a Financial Instrument Valuation Model
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new financial instrument valuation model for assessing the value of various financial instruments based on specific criteria. Make sure to provide all necessary details in the request body to ensure the model is created successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update financial instrument valuation models. Ensure that all required fields are provided for successful processing.

201.description: The financial instrument valuation model has been created successfully.
